message: We have a lot of appointment chaos and patient admin problems. We need something to help us run clinics more smoothly.
Who are the different users or roles that will use this system?

We have a mix of front desk staff who handle booking and check-in, nurses who manage intake, and various doctors and specialists across our departments. Our clinic managers and administrators also need access for oversight and reporting. Everyone has different permissions, so we need to make sure staff only see what is relevant to their specific role.
Do you operate from a single location or multiple locations or branches?
We are expanding beyond a single location and currently operate across multiple branches. We really need a way to manage all of them without losing visibility or creating local operational chaos.
How do you currently track your inventory, records, or data, and what problems come up?

Right now, we are relying on a patchwork of older software and a surprising amount of manual record-keeping at each front desk, which creates massive blind spots between our branches. Patient history and appointment data often don't sync properly when someone visits a different location, leading to duplicate files and confusion. On top of that, tracking our internal medical supplies and medication stocks is mostly done through scattered spreadsheets, so we end up dealing with unexpected shortages or wasted stock because expiry dates slip past us.
Walk me through what happens in your core daily workflow from start to finish.

The day usually starts with front desk staff reviewing the schedule, checking off arrivals, and making sure intake forms are ready for the nurses. Once a patient is triaged, the doctor handles the consultation and enters any treatment notes, prescriptions, or follow-up orders before sending the patient to check out or pick up medication. Everything has to move quickly, but because our workflows and rules vary a lot by department, a bottleneck in one area tends to back up the entire clinic.
How do payments or transactions get handled and reconciled today?

Right now, front desk cashiers handle everything from basic consultation fees to prescription sales, and each branch reconciles their drawer manually at the end of every shift. It takes a lot of time, and trying to pull together daily reports across all our locations for management review is a real headache. We need something that ties retail payments and reimbursement tracking directly to the patient's record without slowing down the checkout line.
What reporting or visibility do you need across the business?

I need clear visibility into daily patient volume, wait times, and revenue reconciliation across all our branches so I can spot bottlenecks before they disrupt the clinics. It is also critical to track medication stock movement and expiry dates to prevent waste and shortages, all from a single dashboard.
What other tools or systems does this need to work with?

We still have a legacy electronic medical record system at two of our older branches that we cannot completely turn off yet, so whatever we use needs to play nice with it. Aside from that, we rely on standard email and SMS gateways for appointment reminders, and our finance team uses a separate accounting platform for end-of-month reporting.
